options.prompt: Create a genuine transparent-background PNG editorial illustration for a shallow ultra-wide website break, 3:1 landscape. Direction A: ABSTRACT EDITORIAL. Idea: making sense of complexity, bringing scattered context into a useful arrangement. A sparse elegant horizontal composition of irregular tactile paper fragments and fine graphite threads: loosely separated fragments at left, overlapping purposeful connections in centre, a calm small coherent arrangement at right. A few soft hand-torn paper planes, looping fine lines with plenty of negative space; subtle depth and gentle organic asymmetry, no arrows. Warm cream, muted putty, charcoal and restrained oxide red. Style is sophisticated contemporary mixed-media editorial collage with light graphite marks and soft gouache texture. Simpler and more graphic than a detailed pencil scene. No hands, people, desks, laptops, stationery, robots, circuitry, text, numbers, icons, glowing effects, gradients or checkerboard. Foreground illustration only, actual transparent alpha everywhere outside the shapes and threads. Do not paint any background. Keep all artwork inside a shallow central horizontal band, generous margins, nothing cut off. This is calm and thoughtful, not decorative confetti.

Create a genuine transparent-background PNG editorial illustration for a shallow ultra-wide website break, 3:1 landscape. Direction B: LANDSCAPE-LIKE. Idea: finding a workable path through complexity. A beautifully simple horizontal landscape vignette: a winding rust-red footpath moves through a few low softly layered hills, crosses a small modest footbridge over a narrow stream, and arrives at an open clearing. No people, hands or buildings. No sky rectangle or opaque paper ground: the landscape is a floating organically edged illustrated strip on ACTUAL TRANSPARENT alpha background. Foreground hills and path only, with generous transparent negative space above and below. Warm cream, muted putty, mushroom, graphite and a very restrained brick-red path. Style is sophisticated contemporary editorial illustration: simplified organic silhouettes, soft gouache washes and a few delicate graphite contours, not detailed crosshatching or photorealism. Quiet, modest and inviting; no dramatic mountains, sunsets, inspirational poster feel, flags, arrows, glowing effects, text, logos, numbers or checkerboard. All elements fit inside the shallow central horizontal band; nothing cut off. Intended to blend into a warm minimal consultancy website as a brief narrative pause.

Create a genuine transparent-background PNG editorial illustration for a shallow ultra-wide website break, 3:1 landscape. Direction C: RECOGNISABLE WORK, no desk scene. Idea: bringing scattered information into a useful result. Horizontal sequence of just three loosely related groups of tangible information artefacts: on the left overlapping small document sheets and an open folder with one tiny envelope; in the middle two or three connected simple modular blocks, with very fine graphite connection lines; on the right one clear organised briefing sheet with a few abstract horizontal marks and a simple tick. Do not put these in panels or cards. Composition airy, calm and low, asymmetric and handcrafted. Simplified warm editorial gouache and delicate graphite outlines, much less detail than realistic pencil crosshatching. Cream and pale putty papers, mushroom and charcoal details, restrained brick-red accents. No hands, people, table, laptop, coffee, plants, robot, gears, circuitry, glow, dramatic arrows, text, numbers or logos. Background must be ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA, no white or ivory rectangle and no checkerboard. Delicate isolated illustrated objects with transparent negative space around and between them. All objects fit in central shallow horizontal band. A refined little explanatory vignette for a human-centred AI consultancy.
